record_title: Hellmann-Feynman Hermite extrapolation for projected-Hessian penalty paths
provenance: Higher-order asymptotic and interpolation analysis of the constrained-eigenvalue quadratic penalty path introduced in arXiv:2609.18538.
limitations: The higher-order scalar expansion assumes a simple constrained target eigenvalue and is asymptotic for large penalty. Multiple target eigenvalues require degenerate perturbation theory. Extrapolation can amplify inner eigensolver and floating-point errors; no finite-precision stability theorem or optimal penalty-level selection is proved. Originality is to the best of our knowledge.
